maria: Noticing a p99 spike on /v1/generate after the runtime canary (v3.1.2) landed in us-west1 at ~22:03 UTC. p95 ~+40%, p99 ~+120%. Anyone seeing this?

deploy-bot: canary rollout v3.1.2 -> runtime-pool-us-west1 @ 2026-03-16T22:03:10Z

owen: I see it. Quick traces show a long tail in kernel selection/dispatch; a lot of requests spending time in kernel_switch and waiting on a queue.

anil: Logs look suspiciously like KV cache miss rate jumped right after canary. Commit abc123 touched cache key hashing. Could be cache warming + kernel path combo.

liam: Prometheus snapshot: http://prometheus.internal/graph?g0.p95=/v1/generate&g0.p99=/v1/generate (linked for context). p99 tail aligns with canary start.

sara: Are these coming from batched workloads? The canary config changed batching.window_ms from 8 -> 12 in v3.1.2. That could amplify tail latency.

maria: Repro steps I've run: 1) issue auth token 2) wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --latency POST /v1/generate with body '{"input":"long prompt repeated"}' 3) inspect p95/p99. Easy to reproduce in us-west1 canary nodes.

owen: snippet from runtime logs: "[2026-03-16T22:05:01Z] request_id=abc kernel_select() took 58ms -> fallback to generic_conv"

anil: Hypothesis: kernel_selector change picks an int8-ish kernel that performs poorly on certain seq lengths; fallback path has queueing.

liam: Quick mitigation attempt: toggled kernel_selector -> legacy on the canary group: `rti-cli flag set kernel_selector=legacy --scope canary`. Observed p99 drop ~30% within 3m but not fully to baseline.

sara: Also tried clearing prefix/KV cache on canary nodes: `kubectl exec -n rti deployment/runtime -- /opt/rti/clear_cache`. That reduced cold-miss tail a bit.

maria: Decision: pause the canary rollout and rollback us-west1 to v3.1.1 while we bisect. Executed: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n rti --to-revision=3.1.1`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for deployment/runtime @ 2026-03-16T22:25:10Z

deploy-bot: Rollback completed for deployment/runtime @ 2026-03-16T22:28:55Z

owen: Post-rollback monitoring: p95/p99 returned to baseline within ~10m. We'll run a git-bisect across the commits  abc120..abc125 (kernel_selector + cache key changes) tomorrow.

anil: Action items: - add a targeted unit/regression test for kernel selection on long sequences - add a canary alert: if p99 > baseline * 1.3 for 5m => auto-pause rollout - improve canary load harness to include KV cache warmup

sara: I'll open a support ticket for affected customers and propose credits where SLA impacts occurred.

maria: Assigning owner: owen to drive the bisect and PRs. Tagging eng-ml for kernel path review and eng-sre for improved canary alerts.

oncall: Collecting traces + flamegraphs now. Trace ids: [trace-21X, trace-21Y, trace-21Z]. Saving heap/profile dumps to s3://rti-debug/us-west1/2229001111/

owen: I'll post bisect results and a follow-up postmortem doc after root cause confirmed. Thanks for the quick rollback help.

maria: Note for process: include KV cache warmup in canary validation and make batching.window change gated behind perf regression checks.

owen: Opening PR with detailed bisect notes and the rollback playbook: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/3421

maria: resolving for now — moving to follow-up channel for root-cause analysis and postmortem.
